description: This file defines a class FontStyles that demonstrates various font styles when drawing text onto a PDF document using the PDFsharp library. It creates a PDF with different text styles, such as regular, bold, italic, underlined, crossed out, and combinations thereof.

classes.name: FontStyles
classes.description: A class that inherits from FeatureTestBase, designed to demonstrate font style rendering in a PDF document.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: An asynchronous method that creates a PDF document with text demonstrating various font styles.
